description: Fixed-seed canary on the three tasks that succeeded in the Group 1 gate, after repairing natural XML boolean/null inference and single-point array decoding. This is a diagnostic precursor, not a replacement for the full Object10 quality gate.

integration_invariants: natural true/false/null XML scalars preserve JSON-equivalent types
single SAM3 point objects are promoted to the ToolContract array shape
isolated sub-agents retain JSON response contracts
ToolContract and provider retry/budget authority remain unchanged

metadata.promotion_rule: at least one objective success and materially fewer XML type/array validation retries before rerunning full Object10
